DevTools JSHeapUsedSize is main-renderer JS heap, not worker/WASM/GPU/model memory.

guidance.note: Used current package guides; local skill update is a separate owner action.

authorVisualInspection.findings: Read desktop and mobile contact sheets. Initial practical select expanded/clipped the mobile viewport; wrapping/min-inline-size fix now keeps all 8 cells at the exact viewport with no clipped controls. Native memory pending state and final token rate are visible.

regressions.preFixMemory: The baseline never-settling memory fixture failed to return within 150ms; corrected 30ms-deadline fixture returns null, preserves single-flight, ignores late sample and allows model load/disposal.
regressions.tokens: Greedy 40-token runs produce 31 decoded text chunks, proving why a text callback count is not a token count.
regressions.constructor: document.createElement(model-run-status) failed because the constructor set a host attribute; initial hidden state now belongs to connectedCallback.
